REGULAR MEETING
OF THE
CITY COUNCIL AND
REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY

07:00 P.M.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, BLOOMFIELD AVENUE AT 183RD STREET
A G E N D A
Public input will be allowed on all Agenda items at the time each matter comes up for discussion. Please complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card to ensure that you are recognized when the Agenda item is considered.

10A.
Development Code Amendment 2004-2 – An ordinance of the City of Cerritos adding Sections 15.04.130 and 15.04.140 to the Cerritos Municipal Code for the purpose of establishing regulations pertaining to the timely commencement and completion of projects authorized by precise plans, conditional use permits or building permits
10B.
Development Code Amendment 2004-3/Negative Declaration – An ordinance of the City of Cerritos amending Chapter 22.70, Development Standards, of the Cerritos Municipal Code relating to the regulation of paint color, material, and treatment of residential building exteriors as well as walls and fences
10C.
An ordinance of the City of Cerritos amending Chapter 9.48 of the Cerritos Municipal Code to define a tent and to restrict the type of tent or shelter that can be erected in public parks
